note: Both sets are dominated by vague dimension claims with speculative entity names, and both include the unsupported callout 'L300X14'/'L300x14', which does not appear in the page text layer (only L3X3X1/4 and 3/8" THROUGH BOLT are present). Set A adds several invented attributes and conditions (e.g., 'offset distance (right/left)', 'flange width (right)', 'bottom section', 'top extension', 'from top') and misbinds dimensions across the two details: 10'-3 3/4" is a Module B (C1) dimension but is labeled Module A, 2'-3 7/8" is a Module A (A1) dimension but is labeled Module B, and the value 12' 2 5/8" does not exist on the page at all. Set B keeps the module bindings mostly consistent with the two details (3'-6", 1'-11 1/8", 4 3/4", 1 1/2") and correctly records the 3/8" through bolt, though it also misbinds 2'-11 7/8" (a Module A dimension) to Module B and invents attributes such as 'thickness' for 5/8" and 'upper section height'. Overall Set B is more faithful with fewer fabricated conditions and misbindings.
